2608.03249.title: One Knob to Rule Them All: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Cold-Start Active Learning
2608.03249.paper_summary: Cold-Start Active Learning (CSAL) aims to select a valuable subset from an unlabeled pool without any prior knowledge or human assistance. Existing methods take diverse routes based on typicality, coverage, or diversity. Each rests on its own inductive bias and therefore performs well on some tasks yet poorly on others. We argue that the real challenge is not to design yet another selection heuristic, but to make CSAL adapt automatically to the data and task at hand. To this end, we revisit CSAL through the lens of optimal transport. First, we propose a generalized transport selection framework that reveals the shared allocation structure of existing methods and exactly subsumes representative formulations. Second, we introduce a theoretical analysis that characterizes the trade-off controlled by entropic regularization and establishes a task-agnostic minimax bound for cold-start selection. These results provide a principled foundation for adapting the regularization strength to the unlabeled data. Third, we derive a data-adaptive regularization rule and present a novel Sinkhorn-based CSAL algorithm, termed $ε$-Adaptive Selection ($ε$-AS). Extensive experiments on six public datasets and multiple annotation budgets show that $ε$-AS consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. On ImageNet-1k, it improves the average accuracy over ActiveFT by 1.29% while reducing selection time by 56.2%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL
2608.03249.paper_summary_zh: 冷啟動主動學習（CSAL）旨在從未標記的資料池中選擇一個有價值的子集，而不需要任何先前的知識或人類協助。現有的方法基於典型性、覆蓋率或多樣性採取不同的路徑。每種方法都有其自身的歸納偏見，因此在某些任務上表現良好，而在其他任務上表現不佳。我們認為真正的挑戰不在於設計另一種選擇啟發式，而在於使CSAL自動適應當前的數據和任務。為此，我們通過最佳運輸的視角重新審視CSAL。首先，我們提出了一個通用的運輸選擇框架，揭示了現有方法的共享分配結構，並精確地包含了代表性的公式。其次，我們引入了一個理論分析，描述了由熵正則化控制的權衡，並為冷啟動選擇建立了一個與任務無關的最小最大界限。這些結果為調整正則化強度以適應未標記數據提供了原則性基礎。第三，我們推導了一個數據自適應的正則化規則，並提出了一種新穎的基於Sinkhorn的CSAL算法，稱為$ε$-自適應選擇（$ε$-AS）。在六個公共數據集和多個標註預算上的廣泛實驗顯示，$ε$-AS始終實現了最先進的性能。在ImageNet-1k上，它將平均準確率提高了1.29%，同時將選擇時間減少了56.2%。代碼將在https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL發布。
